invariants.name: INV-1 invariant_1_conservationClosure (+ per-call identity in Run17Handler)
invariants.description: On every autoAnnihilate call, owed == annihilatable + rawMinted + carriedDust exactly; globally, Antimatter supply == issued - burned and none is stranded on the staker.

invariants.name: INV-2 invariant_2_noOverEmission
invariants.description: Antimatter ever issued plus everything still owed never exceeds the integral of elapsed * antimatterPerSecond over Active, non-empty windows.

invariants.name: INV-3 invariant_3_principal
invariants.description: sum(user.amount) == pool.totalStaked exactly, and totalStaked <= strategy.principalOf(this) (idle pool: <= token.balanceOf(this)).

invariants.name: INV-4 invariant_4_stakerSet
invariants.description: _stakers membership matches user.amount > 0 exactly, in both directions and in cardinality.

invariants.name: INV-5 invariant_5_noAntimatterWhileClaimDisabled
invariants.description: Operator-expected property: no Antimatter reaches a user while claimEnabled == false.

invariants.name: INV-6 invariant_6_autoAnnihilateNeverShortfallsOnAnHonestStrategy
invariants.description: autoAnnihilate must not revert 'StableStaker: exit shortfall' when no strategy preview is lying.
